# ARKhives 8.16.0 — coordinated learning across devices

8 November 2026

## Mobile interface

- Sign-in is an isolated screen. The dashboard and navigation cannot appear below it while signing in or preparing the workspace.
- The dashboard companion/focus-timer hero uses particles only. Waves and grid motion are disabled in that hero on both interfaces.
- Mobile keeps its own interface source. Building a desktop learning update no longer replaces the mobile layout.

## One learning engine

- Desktop and mobile share the authoritative FSRS rating calculation, previews, queues, controls, Undo, MCQ observations, coverage, adaptive practice, reinforcement, weakness analysis, achievements and learning totals.
- Published releases identify the actual engine, progress protocol, content schema and supported features. The mobile engine is an immutable, checksum-verified file.
- Supported clients pause cloud uploads if they detect a different published engine. An update never silently resets the learner's progress. Older desktop versions must install this update to gain that protection.
- A session using an older version of an edited question is retained as unscored instead of being graded against an answer the learner did not study.
- Fixed mastery proof verification when desktop and browser write equivalent timestamps with different fractional-second spelling.

## Question bank distribution

- Approved desktop edits publish the actual questions, flashcards, explanations and mapped media through revisioned bank commits.
- Compatible desktop installations now download complete published reviewer changes and missing images automatically. Mobile checks the same bank catalog.
- Existing progress stays separate from reviewer content. Active study/editor sessions defer replacement; unpublished administrator/editor changes are protected from incoming replacements.
- A fresh administrator installation cannot silently publish an older local bank over an existing online reviewer without an acknowledged publication baseline.
- New downloads are checked before the content commit. Previous desktop reviewer content is backed up. Existing immutable media and account-scoped saved mobile reviewers are reused.
- Learning & sync shows the engine and question-bank status.

## Coordinated release checks

The release workflow blocks distribution unless native tests, actual compiled native/WebAssembly comparisons, browser acceptance, a desktop-edit → mobile-study → native-schedule round trip, and patch-signature verification pass. Desktop publication verifies that the matching mobile engine and interface build are already live. Presentation files do not change the engine identity.

## Practical limits

Automatic progress sync runs while clients are active and resumes after reconnection; suspended or closed browsers cannot guarantee instant delivery. Conflicting concurrent resets/Undo can require attention. Newly added features still need an interface on each supported device; the release checks do not invent one automatically. Physical iPhone/iPad and long-term multi-user load acceptance remain separate from browser tests. This release does not certify the accuracy of every bank question or complete the earlier ARKstudio/editor/art milestones.
